system.description:
The source of your powers is your brilliant mind. You have put your staggering intellect to the task of fighting crime.

Powers

Assign all the dice you rolled at the end of the background step to any of the following powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.KaCyS15sdeKfi3g1]{Inventions}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.kQBxHAqBwDrh07qB]{Robotics}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• Select from Intellectual powers category

Abilities

Gain two of these Yellow abilities, each using a different power:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.0UZRXFzHY5gjHA7a]{A Plan For Everything}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.tdjOB1AWZU34YQ8v]{Expanded Mind}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.2Tk4yMkjjKWgBlfG]{Overwhelming Vision}
Additional Info

Select an extra quality from the Information or Mental quality categories at d10.

Archetype

Roll d10, d6, d6 for archetype selection.
